name: Llacheau
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: an illegitimate son of King Arthur
a lesser figure kept near the king

text: Llacheau (Lohot) is an Arthurian hero. The source calls this obscure figure the illegitimate son of King Arthur. He appears among the lesser names the later stories kept near the king without giving them a noted part of their own. The record marks him as a member of the Arthurian family rather than as a leading figure.

okr.objective: Say plainly who Llacheau is in the Arthurian list.
key_results: State his birth as an illegitimate son of King Arthur.
Mark him as a lesser figure of the court.
